in_sanskrit.name: Bhagvat
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: भगवत् (bhagavat) means blessed, fortunate, godly, divine.

in_hindi.name: बहगवत
in_hindi.meaning: बहगवत (bahagvat) translates to Blessed, Fortunate, Godly, Divine.

in_marathi.name: Bhagvat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhagvat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is blessed by the gods and carries their teachings and blessings.

in_bengali.name: Bhagvat
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhagvat একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is blessed by the gods and carries their teachings and blessings.
